mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ALARM WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND IS_READ = 'N'

SELECT A.ALARM_ID, A.TYPE, A.TITLE, A.CONTENT, A.LINK_ID, A.IS_READ, A.CREATED_AT,
CR.STATUS AS REQUEST_STATUS, CR.ROOM_ID AS CHAT_ROOM_ID
FROM ALARM A LEFT JOIN CHAT_REQUEST CR ON A.TYPE = 'CHAT_REQUEST' AND A.LINK_ID = CR.REQUEST_ID WHERE A.USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY A.ALARM_ID DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE ALARM SET IS_READ = 'Y' WHERE ALARM_ID = #{alarmId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO alarm (USER_ID, TYPE, TITLE, CONTENT, LINK_ID, LINK_URL, IS_READ, CREATED_AT) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{type}, #{title}, #{content}, NULLIF(#{linkId}, ''), NULLIF(#{linkUrl}, ''), 'N', NOW() )
